title: 第15章 有人打起了去看看热闹第16章 长的像麻匪的衙差
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 郑常穿越过来后，第一次早上没有睡到自然醒。
耳边传来敖青的声音。
“喂，郑常，快醒醒。附近来人了。”
郑常还有些迷糊，嘟囔道：“别闹了，我再睡会。”
敖青见他不起，吐出信子，在他耳朵上舔了一下。
郑常当即一个激灵，半点睡意也没有了。伸手捂住了耳朵说道。
“我靠，敖青你不是公的吗？你好这口？”
“嘘！小声点，附近有人，你没听到吗？”
风龙族身上都是上好的素材，自己又是风龙族被放逐的族人，就算出事了风龙族也不会追究。
若是被人发现了身份，说不定就要被人抓去拔鳞抽筋，拆骨割肉了。
“有人就有人嘛，你紧张什么？”郑常从铺盖里出来，收拾收拾，考虑起了要去哪里洗漱了。
“你真不懂还是装傻？风龙族的身体都是上好的素材，让人发现不得活拆了我？”
郑常一愣，然后从储物空间拿出了一面镜子照向敖青。
“你是不是忘了你现在是蛇了？”
敖青推开镜子答道：“我当然知道，可我这不是还能恢复吗？培养我突破筑基的资源可比杀掉一条风龙获得的资源少多了。”
“可别人怎么知道你能恢复成风龙呢？”
“修仙界人才济济，你莫要小看了修士的手段，望气、问卜、瞳术。要看清楚底细的办法多得数都数不完”
郑常还是觉得对方小题大做了。
“没必要这样紧张吧？”
“你当我为什么就剩下个头藏在那瀑布底下的溶洞里？”
“为什么？”郑常跳过了剧情，确实是不知道为什么。
“我这不是被族人追缉，不得舍弃了肉身躲藏起来的嘛。”
“等一下，这和你怕人有什么关系，抓你的不是你们风龙族人吗？”
“肯定有关系啊，我就是被修士骗了，才会被族人当作叛徒的嘛。”
郑常连忙打住，这会儿他可不想剧情回顾：“好了好了，你别说了，够绕的了。既然你怕见人，咱们就躲躲就是了。”
他将东西往系统空间里一丢，认真听起周围的动静来。
果然，真的有人在附近说话，听声音是在争吵。
“像是有人在吵架，天没大亮就吵架，气性真大。”
郑常忍不住吐槽道。
收拾好后，郑常就准备带着敖青离开了。
然而，没等他使出御风术，身后就传来了爆炸声。
“额？打起来了？”
郑常有些紧张，前世碰见打架他都躲得远远地。现在要看见修士斗法了？还是赶紧撤吧。
然而他想撤，刚刚想走的敖青又不想走了。
“等一下！郑常，先听听动静。”
“听啥动静啊，打起来了，赶紧跑吧。小心殃及池鱼。”
content_en:
After Zheng Chang traveled through time, it was the first time he didn't sleep until he woke up naturally in the morning.
Ao Qing's voice came to his ears.
"Hey, Zheng Chang, wake up quickly. There's someone nearby."
Zheng Chang was still a little confused and muttered: "Stop making trouble, I'll sleep for a while."
Seeing that he couldn't bear it, Ao Qing spit out the letter and licked his ear.
Zheng Chang immediately became excited and no longer sleepy at all. He reached out and covered his ears.
"Damn it, Ao Qing, aren't you a male? How do you say that?"
"Shh! Keep your voice down, there's someone nearby, didn't you hear it?"
The Wind Dragon Clan is full of good materials, and he is an exiled member of the Wind Dragon Clan. Even if something goes wrong, the Wind Dragon Clan will not pursue him.
If someone discovers his identity, he might be arrested, his scales and muscles pulled out, his bones and flesh cut off.
"There are people, there are people. Why are you nervous?" Zheng Chang came out of the bed, packed up, and considered where to go to wash up.
"Are you really not understanding, or are you just pretending to be stupid? The bodies of the Wind Dragon Clan are all made of fine materials, so why don't people find me and kill me alive?"
Zheng Chang was stunned for a moment, then took out a mirror from the storage space and looked at Ao Qing.
"Have you forgotten that you are a snake now?"
Ao Qing pushed the mirror away and replied: "Of course I know, but can't I still recover? The resources to train me to break through the foundation building are much less than the resources obtained by killing a wind dragon."
"But how do others know that you can transform into a wind dragon?"
"There are many talented people in the world of immortality. Don't underestimate the methods of monks, such as fortune-telling, divination, and pupil skills. There are so many ways to see the truth clearly that you can't even count them all."
Zheng Chang still felt that the other party was making a fuss out of a molehill.
"There's no need to be so nervous, right?"
"Why do you think I am hiding in the cave under the waterfall?"
"Why?" Zheng Chang skipped the plot and really didn't know why.
"I am being hunted by my tribe, so I have to abandon my body and hide."
"Wait a minute, what does this have to do with your fear of people? Isn't it your Wind Dragon clansmen who arrested you?"
"It must be related. I was deceived by the monks, and that's why I was regarded as a traitor by my tribe."
Zheng Chang stopped quickly. He didn't want to review the plot at this moment: "Okay, okay, stop talking, it's enough. Since you are afraid of seeing people, let's just hide."
He threw the things into the system space and listened carefully to the movement around him.
Sure enough, someone was really talking nearby, and the sound sounded like they were arguing.
"It seemed like someone was quarreling. They were quarreling before dawn. They were really angry."
Zheng Chang couldn't help but complain.
After packing up, Zheng Chang was ready to leave with Ao Qing.
However, before he could use the wind control technique, there was an explosion behind him.
"Um? A fight started?"
Zheng Chang was a little nervous. In his previous life, he would stay away from fights. Now we want to see monks fighting? It's better to withdraw quickly.
However, he wanted to leave, but Ao Qing, who just wanted to leave, didn't want to leave anymore.
"Wait a minute! Zheng Chang, listen to the noise first."
"What's the noise? There's a fight. Run away. Be careful not to harm Chi Yu."
title_en: Chapter 15: Someone got into a fight and went to see the fun Chapter 16: A cadre who looks like a gangster
